Original discription:

It's the first day of 2013 in Berlin that feels like spring or even summertime! Standing at S Bhf Greifswalder Str, S-Bahn, Tram, cars, trucks and motorbikes driving past.

Recorded with Zoom H2. Edited with Audacity.

This sound is CC0 but I highly recommend that you include a link to this page when using it, to avoid misunderstandings.
